title: centaurea rhizocalathium
intro: Centaurea rhizocalathium, commonly known as Centaury, is a perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestion, making it beneficial for individuals suffering from gastrointestinal issues, such as irritable bowel syndrome. Centaury is also reported to have therapeutic actions, including calming anxiety and promoting relaxation, thanks to its sedative and anti-anxiety effects. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea rhizocalathium include flavonoids, alkaloids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
